title: Search workbench
idea: Search workbench: A persistent query and filter region faces ranked results; selected detail opens without replacing the search context.
audience: People who need to find record within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: People repeatedly inspect results under several constraints.
avoidWhen: A full workspace would overcomplicate one simple lookup.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic workspace layout through its find record priority and explicit commitment contract: Confirm the selected record identity and current permission before acting on it.
navigation: Search workbench keeps the current find record context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A persistent query and filter region faces ranked results; selected detail opens without replacing the search context.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to find record; people repeatedly inspect results under several constraints.
composition.priority: Confirm the selected record identity and current permission before acting on it.

imagery.role: Support the actual find record context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Move filters into a labelled sheet and detail into a focused route while retaining query and scroll.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the search workbench structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no find record content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Confirm the selected record identity and current permission before acting on it.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized find record content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Confirm the selected record identity and current permission before acting on it.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active find record context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
